name: password-checklist
title: Password checklist
description: Live password rule checklist with a reusable isStrongPassword predicate. Rules mirror the newbie account module's password policy (validator.isStrongPassword defaults: 8+ chars, lower/upper/number/symbol); when the backend policy changes, the rules here must be updated manually.
postInstall: Render <PasswordChecklist password={...}> under password inputs (pairs with the login-form item in sign-up/change-password screens). The rules array is a manual mirror of the newbie account password policy - if the backend strategy changes, sync it here; there is no automatic linkage.
